title: EXP-001 Counterfactual Stability & Sensitivity Study — execution verification
method: Independent verification of the EXP-001 execution: source isolation review, TypeScript build, targeted test suite, seed-repetition determinism check, guard assertions, and reconciliation of measured outputs against the recorded resource ledger

evidence.determinism: identical seed range run twice; deep-diff shows only createdAt, diff.capturedAt, runtimeMs differ; all simulation content byte-identical
evidence.guards: matchedHorizon=true and baselineIdentical=true on all runs
evidence.isolation: exp-001 observer sector appended last; five P-004 sectors' RNG draw sequence unchanged; no frozen artifact modified
evidence.validation: N=1000 x H=10/20/50; 3000 runs; degeneracy 58.4%/84.5%/93.7%; funnel adapter-translation 0%/0%/45.8%; sentinel 0%
evidence.primary: N=10000 x H=10/20; 20000 runs; FDR-significant 13/12 vs expected-FP 11.8/13.9 (at/below noise floor)

budgetGate.action: H=50 primary omitted; characterised at validation scale (N=1000) only

verdictSummary: EXP-001 COMPLETE — STRUCTURAL NULL. Intervention effect is real and reproducible inside the targeted climate sector but never propagates to any clinical/hospital outcome. Recommendation: STOP (no Stage C 50k).
notes: Verification confirms the experiment executed from a clean baseline, is deterministic, respected the frozen-evidence boundary, and stayed within the Stage B budget gate. The budget-driven omission of the H=50 primary is documented in config.json (primaryH50Omitted) and the report.
